\[
f \circ B = (f \ominus B) \oplus B
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

Erosion removes every bright detail the element does not fit into, and dilation brings the remaining objects back to their size. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
